baseline_models.focus_anchor: The two occurrences of awla at words 1 and 3 share the root و ل ي and are joined by fa.
baseline_models.mechanism: Gapless nearness plus one-thing-after-another succession lets the repeated form stage two approaching beats, with fa minimizing the interval between them.

activation_trace.role: Gapless nearness supplies the spatial pressure of something closing directly upon the addressee.
Continuous succession makes the second awla a following beat rather than a restatement detached from the first.

changed_reading.before: An opaque doubled warning addressed to you.
changed_reading.after: Two successive contacts are closing in on you, the second immediately following the first.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: Each awla is directed by laka to the same addressee.
baseline_models.mechanism: The priority or superior-right branch reads awla as what is more due, while the conferral branch gives laka a recipient function; repetition intensifies an assigned outcome.

activation_trace.role: Priority and superior right supply the judgment that an unnamed outcome is especially fitting or due.
Assigning good or evil to someone makes laka the endpoint of a directed allotment.

changed_reading.after: What is due is assigned specifically to you, and then assigned again with greater insistence.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The repeated و ل ي forms address a bounded recipient and terminate twice on laka.
baseline_models.mechanism: Assuming charge and reaching or taking possession combine into a claim that arrives at its endpoint in the addressee; the pair sounds like successive acts of taking charge.

activation_trace.role: Assuming charge supplies an authority that takes the addressee's affair in hand.
Taking possession or reaching a goal turns each repetition into arrival at the addressed endpoint.

changed_reading.before: A wish that harm befall the addressee.
changed_reading.after: A superior claim reaches you and takes charge of your outcome in two strokes.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: Both repeated words carry a root whose inventory holds opposed movements of facing and withdrawal.
baseline_models.mechanism: The same root can turn toward or turn away; doubling around laka permits a compact reversal formula in which direction itself is turned back upon the addressee.

activation_trace.role: Turning toward and facing supplies motion directed toward the addressee.
Turning away and withdrawal supplies the opposed motion that makes a reversal possible.

changed_reading.before: A fixed exclamation with no internal direction.
changed_reading.after: A doubled turning formula redirects motion toward you and leaves open an ironic reversal of your own withdrawal.

context_deltas.mechanism: The announced rising, failed search for escape, absence of refuge, sovereign destination, and fixed settlement turn baseline nearness into a closing terminal corridor: what approaches cannot be sidestepped because every route ends at the same authority.

activation_trace.role: Gapless nearness anchors the focus line as an approach that has nearly eliminated distance.
Reaching a goal or taking possession supplies the endpoint toward which the approach closes.
Resurrection and the rising of the Hour supply the named terminal event that is approaching.
Flight and escape supply the attempted outward route whose failure makes the approach enclosing.
The refuge branch supplies the denied shelter, removing a place where the addressee could interrupt the approach.
Lordship, ownership, and sovereignty identify the authority at the corridor's end.
Fixity and settlement make that endpoint stable rather than another point of transit.

structural_cues: 75:1 names the rising Day before 75:10-12 compresses flight, no refuge, and final settlement into one movement.
The focus line's two short clauses reproduce that compression as repeated arrivals at laka.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a rising event, attempted flight, denied refuge, sovereign endpoint, and settlement; I infer that this route-closure gives the focus root's nearness a directional arrow toward reckoning. A live alternative is that these verses establish only the threat's topic while awla remains an idiomatic malediction.

changed_reading.before: Two unspecified things come near in succession.
changed_reading.after: The terminal reckoning closes directly upon you twice within a route from which every refuge has been removed.

context_deltas.mechanism: Blame, the self as the thing itself, inward sight, and attempted excuse make the assigned outcome evidential rather than arbitrary: laka receives what the self already recognizes as due.

activation_trace.role: Superior right anchors the focus outcome as deserved rather than merely nearby.
Directed assignment makes the repeated laka the recipient of that deserved outcome.
Reproach for what merits blame supplies an internal standard of desert.
The self as the very thing itself makes the addressee, not an external proxy, bear the verdict.
Insight of the heart supplies self-recognition before any external sentence is imposed.
Excuse and apology supply the attempted defense that cannot erase self-knowledge.

structural_cues: 75:2 opens with the blaming self, while 75:14-15 place self-insight before proffered excuses.
The singular laka in 75:34 points the outcome back to that same accountable self.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies blame, self-identity, inward sight, and excuses; I infer that recognized responsibility licenses the focus line's assignment of what is due. The alternative is a wholly external threat that does not voice or ratify the self's own verdict.

changed_reading.before: An authority assigns an unnamed outcome to you.
changed_reading.after: Your own seeing self has already furnished the grounds for the outcome now pronounced due to you twice.

context_deltas.mechanism: The audience gives affective priority to the immediate and leaves the later; awla's superior-right branch answers with a counter-priority, declaring that the deferred outcome has the stronger claim on the addressee.

activation_trace.role: Priority and superior right anchor the focus form as an adjudication between rival claims.
Haste and bringing forward supply the temporal preference for what arrives first.
Love fixed in the heart makes that temporal preference affective and chosen.
Leaving a thing supplies the active abandonment of the competing later claim.
Laterness after the first supplies the deferred horizon whose priority the focus line restores.

structural_cues: 75:20-21 is an explicit antithesis: loving the immediate versus leaving the later.
The repeated awla follows that antithesis as a rival statement of what is truly prior or more entitled.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies chosen immediacy and abandoned laterness; I infer that awla's priority branch reverses the audience's ranking and gives the deferred outcome superior claim. It remains possible that the antithesis only explains misconduct and does not control the focus word's semantics.

changed_reading.before: What is due is assigned to you without an explicit rival claim.
changed_reading.after: The later reality you demoted now outranks the immediate one you loved and asserts its doubled claim upon you.

context_deltas.mechanism: Arrival at the throat, recognized separation, bodily wrapping, and compulsory driving form a material sequence already in motion; the two awla beats become the next installments of that process rather than a detached curse.

activation_trace.role: Gapless nearness anchors the focus pair as stages that have come bodily close.
Continuous succession makes each awla another stage following the preceding death scene.
Reaching the goal supplies the terminal vector of the sequence.
Arrival at a limit supplies the first explicit threshold in the bodily sequence.
Separation between two things supplies death's recognized division.
One thing wrapping upon another supplies the body's constricted, folded stage.
Driving and impelling supply compulsory motion toward the endpoint.
Following in one track mirrors the focus pair's one-stage-after-another cadence.

structural_cues: 75:26-30 advances verse by verse from reaching the throat to separation, entwining, and the drive to the Lord.
75:34's fa links its second short beat with the same sense of a process that does not pause.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies successive bodily thresholds and a final drive; I infer that the focus repetition continues this process as two more consequences arriving in sequence. The alternative is that the death scene merely motivates a conventional threat without entering its internal cadence.

changed_reading.before: Two approaching warnings with no specified process.
changed_reading.after: Two further stages of the death-to-destination process are now upon you, each following the last without release.

context_deltas.mechanism: The exact root first names the subject's turning away, then reappears as awla after his extended swagger; the focus line can therefore return his chosen direction to him, converting withdrawal from truth into a consequence directed back toward him.

activation_trace.role: Assigning good or evil directs the returned consequence to laka.
Turning away and withdrawal supply the subject's immediately preceding chosen motion.
Swagger through an extended posture makes the withdrawal socially displayed rather than merely inward.

structural_cues: 75:31-33 moves from not affirming or praying, to denying and turning away, to going home swaggering.
Tawalla in 75:32 and awla in 75:34 place visibly different forms of the same root across only one intervening ayah.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies withdrawal, displayed swagger, and the same root in the focus; I infer a retaliatory directional arrow in which his turning is returned as an assigned consequence. A live alternative is wordplay without semantic reversal: tawalla states the offense and awla independently states its desert.

changed_reading.before: A doubled assignment of deserved harm.
changed_reading.after: Your own turning away is turned back toward you as the doubled consequence now assigned to you.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus pair is itself followed by an exact second pair: fa binds each local pair tightly, while thumma spaces the pairs. Nearness and succession thus become a four-beat schedule with both immediate and deferred intervals.

activation_trace.role: Continuous succession anchors the two focus occurrences as one tightly coupled pair.
The repeated context pair supplies a second succession, extending the focus's two beats into four.

structural_cues: 75:34 has awla laka fa-awla; 75:35 repeats the full pair after thumma.
Fa marks within-pair continuation, whereas thumma marks the transition between the two pairs.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies exact repetition plus two different sequencing particles; I infer a cadence of two near consequences followed by another delayed pair. The materially live alternative is intensive repetition with no distinct temporal installments.

changed_reading.before: The focus contains one doubled warning.
changed_reading.after: The focus is the first coupled installment of a four-beat sequence: near consequence, immediate follower, then another pair after an interval.

context_deltas.mechanism: The following question denies that the human will simply be released; this revises the focus authority model from hostile takeover to continuing jurisdiction, in which a claim remains attached to the addressee and will not leave him ungoverned.

activation_trace.role: Assuming charge and authority anchors the focus as a claim over the addressee's affair.
Superior right supplies the claim's entitlement to continue.
Supposition supplies the mistaken expectation that frames the following denial.
Letting go or relinquishing supplies precisely the release that the question rejects.

structural_cues: 75:36 immediately follows the four awla beats and asks whether the human expects to be left suda.
The interrogative expects rejection, so relinquishment is placed as the denied alternative to the focus line.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a mistaken expectation and the prospect of being relinquished; I infer its negation and read the focus authority branch as the countercondition of continued claim. An alternative is that 75:36 opens a fresh creation argument and does not retrospectively define awla.

changed_reading.before: A superior force arrives and takes possession as punishment.
changed_reading.after: The doubled formula marks that you remain under a rightful claim: you will not simply be released without direction or consequence.

context_deltas.mechanism: Measured origin, creating, completing form, effective capacity, life, and death give the claiming-endpoint baseline a full arc: the agency that first determined the person can carry him through death to restored life, so the claim reaches both origin and terminus.

activation_trace.role: Assuming charge anchors the focus as jurisdiction over the person's whole trajectory.
Reaching a goal supplies the trajectory's terminal completion.
The seminal substance from which form is determined supplies the person's measured beginning.
Bringing creation into existence supplies originating agency.
Straightness and completion in the thing itself supply finished formation.
Effective capacity to perform and possess supplies power to complete the asserted claim.
Living spirit supplies the restored state toward which the final question points.
Loss of force and life supplies the boundary that originating capacity is asserted to cross.

structural_cues: 75:37-40 moves from seminal beginning through formation and pairing to the capacity to give life to the dead.
This origin-to-return proof immediately follows the focus refrain and the denial of abandonment.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies measured beginning, creation, completed form, capacity, life, and death; I infer that originating and restoring agency grounds the focus line's continuing claim over the addressee. The alternative is narrower: these details prove resurrection without implying the possession or jurisdiction branch of و ل ي.

changed_reading.before: An authority takes charge at a threatening endpoint.
changed_reading.after: The authority that measured your beginning retains its claim through death and can bring that claim to its endpoint in renewed life.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because the late-rain branch is remote from the conventional force of awla; it remains anchored in the exact focus root and is activated by the packet's rain-based life branch beside life-from-death. Downstream prose should present it only as an ecological sequence analogy, never as the lexical translation of 75:34.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus root's B010 branch names a rain that follows an earlier seasonal rain, and the focus itself repeats the form with fa.

activation_trace.role: Late rain following an earlier rain supplies a second visitation arriving after the first.
Earth revived through rain and vegetation supplies the ecological mechanism for return after apparent lifelessness.
Loss of force and life supplies the dry or dead condition crossed by the second visitation.

changed_reading.before: The doubled form only intensifies doom.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, the pair patterns two visitations like follow-up rain, allowing the later life-from-death question to cast repetition as return after apparent finality.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This material inversion is form-distant: an under-saddle cloth is not a plausible direct gloss of awla. It remains traceable because that branch belongs to the focus root and meets adjacent branches of riding on a back and being driven; render it only as an imagistic reversal of swagger, not as philology.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus root's B011 branch supplies an object placed under a saddle or pack on an animal's back.

activation_trace.role: The under-saddle pad supplies the material position of something borne beneath a rider's equipment.
Driving and impelling supply the forced journey that reverses self-directed swagger.
Riding on the back supplies the posture whose agency is inverted when the rider becomes borne and driven.

changed_reading.before: The swaggering addressee receives a verbal threat.
changed_reading.after: As a contained material echo, the swaggering rider is stripped of control and placed into the apparatus of the drive toward his destination.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: The resale-at-cost branch is a specialized commercial sense and therefore too distant to govern a translation. It remains anchored by the focus root, laka's recipient direction, and the packet's counting plus forward-and-deferred record; downstream use should label it a legal-commercial analogy for exact liability.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus root's B014 branch describes transferring a purchase to another at its known original price, while laka identifies a recipient.

activation_trace.role: Transfer at a known cost supplies a commercial image of liability passed to the addressed party without altered valuation.
Counting and account supply the valuation mechanism for the transferred liability.
Advancing something forward supplies one side of the recorded conduct whose cost returns.
Deferring something to a later time supplies the other side of the account without removing it.

changed_reading.before: An undefined punishment is assigned to you.
changed_reading.after: As a contained commercial analogy, your recorded liability is transferred back to you at its exact cost, including what you advanced and what you deferred.

strongest_changes: The no-flight and fixed-destination sequence turns abstract nearness into an enclosing approach with no interrupting refuge.
The immediate tawalla-to-awla root recurrence returns the addressee's turning away as a consequence directed back toward him.
The exact repetition in 75:35, with fa inside each pair and thumma between pairs, expands the focus into a four-beat schedule of near and deferred installments.
Loving the immediate while leaving the later activates awla as a reversal of priority: the deferred reality has the superior claim.
The denial of being left suda and the origin-to-return proof recast menace as continuing jurisdiction from first formation through renewed life.
summary.what_was_special: The whole-surah packet made one terse refrain function simultaneously as approach, desert, returned direction, temporal sequencing, and continuing claim. Its nearest context produced the strongest reversal, while specialized branches preserved ecological, transport, and commercial analogies without promoting them to translations.
remaining_uncertainties: The exact grammatical force of awla can sustain the strong desert reading more cleanly than the spatial, directional, or possession readings.
The four repetitions may be pure intensification rather than distinct temporal installments.
The claim or jurisdiction reading depends on linking 75:36-40 backward to the refrain rather than treating those ayat as a new proof section.
The rain, saddle, and resale branches are deliberately retained outliers and should remain explicitly analogical.
